opensearch.distribution: official Linux x64 tarball with bundled JDK
opensearch.verification: detached signature and official signing-key fingerprint; local SHA-512 also recorded

snapshot.distribution: OpenSearch CI nightly bundle of the next release, built from main: Linux x64 tarball with bundled JDK and the release plugin set
snapshot.verification: CI publishes no checksum or signature for nightly bundles; the server jar's commit must match the build manifest's, and a local SHA-512 is recorded

elasticsearch.distribution: official default Linux x86_64 tarball with bundled JDK
elasticsearch.license: Elastic License 2.0 distribution; free source is also available under AGPLv3
elasticsearch.verification: published SHA-512 sidecar, checked by download.sh

snapshot.distribution: Elastic snapshot build of main: default Linux x86_64 tarball with bundled JDK
snapshot.license: Elastic License 2.0 distribution; free source is also available under AGPLv3
snapshot.verification: published SHA-512 sidecar; the server jar's commit must match the build manifest's

notes: OpenSearch signing-key fingerprint was verified against the official key endpoint after its post-2025 rotation.
Elasticsearch's Elastic License 2.0 has no benchmark-publication restriction. Elasticsearch's free source has also offered the OSI-approved AGPLv3 option since 8.16.

Each snapshot block names the next release line. engines/download.sh <engine>-snapshot installs its newest official build; OPENSEARCH_BUILD / ELASTICSEARCH_BUILD select it (python/installs.py). Bump a snapshot version when that release ships.
